Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. input_dist(ctx, KJT) feature reorder + optional unique _input_dists[row_wise](features) bucketize rows by owner rank _dist(bucketized_features) Input stage totals 3 AllToAll calls: splits now; lengths + ID values at the first wait below. wait().wait() -> received KJT First wait: read receive sizes, launch lengths + ID values AllToAll. Second wait: consume payload and recat the KJT. _lookups[row_wise](received KJT) BatchedFusedEmbedding -> FBGEMM TBE _output_dists[row_wise](embeddings) 1 AllToAll call: return embedding vectors to requesting ranks via SequenceEmbeddingsAllToAll. return SequenceEmbeddingsAwaitable wrapped by EmbeddingCollectionAwaitable wait() unbucketize unique rows; then reverse_indices restores duplicates

g.title: WAIT · consume request; not a blanket host barrier

svg.text: IN and OUT summarize module stages. Count per rank, per row-wise group: 3 input + 1 output = 4 forward AllToAll collective calls.
The input total spans _dist() and the first wait. Backward gradient communication is separate. Weights or variable stride add payload tensors.
Counts refer to PyTorch collective calls using the NCCL backend; they do not count NCCL send/recv primitives or GPU kernels.
Nested lookup modules not compressed here: GroupedEmbeddingsLookup -> BatchedFusedEmbedding -> SplitTableBatchedEmbeddingBagsCodegen.
KJTAllToAllSplitsAwaitable and KJTAllToAllTensorsAwaitable are Awaitable objects, not nn.Module instances.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
TorchRec 1d87b8f79b7b / Logical scopes, not measured durations. Request wait consumes a handle; stream dependencies order GPU work.
